title: Thai Chicken Braise
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired braise made with tender chicken, crispy herbs, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and sear until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add Thai herbal mixture and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add crumbly tofu (if using) and cook until lightly browned.
Add chilies, fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar (if using). Stir to combine.
Return chicken to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve hot over rice.
